text:
Maya: Quick thread to stop the ping-pong on SI + hardware + marketplace leads. Need a single "orbit" workflow so ownership is predictable.
Diego: 3 main things: canonical source tag, claim lifecycle, and compensation attribution.
Rina: For hardware partners we often see two handoffs: hw->marketplace->si. Propose a precedence order: existing SDR owner > hw partner > marketplace > SI referral, unless SI is invited by account.
Owen: I like precedence but we need explicit timeboxes. My suggestion: initial ingress assigns to canonical queue (24h triage). Then: soft-reserve = 96h for SIs if they submit intro docs; marketplace SDRs get a 48h soft-reserve to qualify leads.
Zoe: Also require partner_evidence field on claim (one-of: intro_email, demo_sched, contract_draft) for hard-claim. If evidence missing, hard-claim denied.
Maya: Field mapping (minimal) so partners don't send random CSVs. This is the canonical mapping we will enforce on ingest: contact_email, contact_name, company_external_id, source_channel, partner_reference_id, estimated_annual_value_usd, evidence_type. If estimated_annual_value_usd > 100000, mark as Strategic and route to Sales Ops.
IngestBot: New lead ingested -> id=L-2025-10-01-120, source=hw/partner-zenith, partner_reference_id=zen-204, estimated_annual_value_usd=135000
Rina: Compensation/attribution note: for co-sell where SI performs >25% of technical work, SI gets primary credit for first-year services fee and 15% success fee on ARR up to $150k, then 7% after. Marketplace bounty (if marketplace introduced) is +3% on first $100k. Final percentages in partners/comp-guides (RevOps will publish).
Diego: Dedupe rules: dedupe key = partner_reference_id || hash(contact_email || company_external_id). Intake returns {canonical_lead_id, dedupe_status, duplicates[]} in response. We'll also emit claim events via webhook topic: leads.claims.v1.
Owen: API example for claim (idempotent): POST /v1/leads/claims { lead_id: "L-2025-10-01-120", claimer: "si-88", claim_type: "soft", evidence_type: "intro_email" } -> 200 reserved or 409 conflict with details.
Zoe: For strategic/white-glove (>$500k or enterprise logo list), require Sales Ops arbitration: halt automatic assignment, open case in sales-arb queue, 12h SLA to decide.
Maya: Joint announcement cadence: if marketplace+SI+hw want a joint press/announce, collect press contacts and legal checklists at ingest and route to marketing_ops@redwood. Announce window = 30-60 days after legal sign-off; track announce_owner in metadata.
Rina: Edge-case: partner re-ingests same account under different partner_ref. Intake must link by company_external_id and surface existing claims. If partner insists new ref, Sales Ops must approve.
Diego: Action items:
- Rina: publish ingest schema + sample CSV and JSON payloads (due Wed COB).
- Owen: implement 96h SI soft-reserve and 48h marketplace reserve; add evidence_type enforcement (due Thu).
- Zoe: draft evidence_type enum and strategic-threshold config for intake (due Wed).
- Maya: create marketing announce checklist template and place in partners/announce-playbook (due Fri).
- Diego: wire webhook topic and make dedupe response include canonical_lead_id (due Thu).
Everyone: drop account ids here if you want them added to the manual-arb list for the pilot.
Maya: Thanks 970 680 this should remove a lot of treadmill pings and make co-sell predictable.
